narrative.overview: A dark, immersive viewing chamber where glowing glass panels float over a plasma field, and the work itself is the exhibit. The portfolio reads like a living control room for a homelab enthusiast: deep void background, translucent glass surfaces, and a single electric-violet accent that carries identity, emphasis, and glow. Motion is purposeful and atmospheric (scroll smoothing, animated text, a 3D Linux mascot that tracks the cursor), never decorative filler. Brand lives in the precise details — the purple glow, the glass blur, the rounded-full CTAs — not in loud chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Dark void canvas (#050505) with a fixed, animated LightPillar shader behind all content.
Glassmorphism as the primary surface language: backdrop-blur, semi-transparent white layers, thin white borders.
Single accent — Electric Violet (#a855f7 / #c084fc) — used for headings, links, glows, borders, and emphasis.
Rounded-full pill CTAs and rounded-2xl glass cards; no sharp corners anywhere.
Geist Sans for all UI/body; Geist Mono only for labels and metadata.
Depth via glow and translucency, not hard drop shadows.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The electric-violet accent appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point; everything else is white, gray, or glass.

rules.name: The No-Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast opaque drop shadows. Depth is conveyed by translucency, blur, and purple glow only.

rules.name: The Glow-Headline Rule
rules.body: Section headlines always carry a purple text-shadow glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.4)]). Body text never does.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, active) or as the ambient headline glow.

dos: Do keep the background transparent (bg-transparent) on content layers so the LightPillar shows through.
Do use Electric Violet (#a855f7) as the single accent; keep it to ≤10% of any screen.
Do use glass surfaces (backdrop-blur + semi-transparent white fill + thin white border) for cards, nav, and modals.
Do apply the purple headline glow to section titles only.
Do disable heavy effects (LightPillar, ScrollSmoother) below the md breakpoint.
Do use rounded-full for all CTAs and rounded-2xl for cards/panels.
Do keep body text in Muted Gray (#9ca3af) / white over the void for readability.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or a light theme; the system is dark-only.
Don't use opaque drop shadows or hard edges on interactive elements.
Don't apply glassmorphism to body text or dense content; reserve it for surfaces.
Don't add new fonts; Geist + Geist Mono only.
Don't let the LightPillar or animations block interaction (pointer-events-none on the background layer).
Don't mix in generic Bootstrap/template layouts or cookie-cutter hero patterns.
